The highest point is about 4,700 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

places-segment-juli-cruz-pata-ccaje-segm.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-segment-juli-cruz-pata-ccaje-segm.story: A 157 km round trip from Juli - roughly 2 h 42 in the saddle. On the way it passes Segment Pomata-Chaca Chaca, Segment Arbolera-Parcco Chua Chua, Segment Desaguadero Titijoni and back through Segment Arbolera-Parcco Chua Chua. The highest point is about 4,100 m. It crosses from Peru into Bolivia - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.

legend-peter-norbeck-scenic-byway.slogan: Peter Norbeck Scenic Byway – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-peter-norbeck-scenic-byway.story: National Scenic Byway. granite spires, pigtail bridges, forest. 38 km from Custer to Custer, about 41 min of riding. The highest point is about 1,850 m. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: Peter Norbeck Scenic Byway
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 9 km this is Peter Norbeck Scenic Byway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
